course_name: 人類資訊處理理論與應用
outline: 此課程旨在使學生了解人類認知過程之資訊處理理論與模式以及其工作與環境之特性，並使學生能應用這些理論與模式來探討與提升整體系統之績效。
schedule:
Week 1: Lecture: Introduction to Human information processing (Read Ch. 1&2 of Ref. book 1)
Week 2: Seminars on 11/5 (Fri.) at 4:00 PM
Week 3: Discussion 1: Ch. 1 and 2 (Read Ch. 3 of Ref. book 1)
Week 4: Discussion 2: Ch. 3 and Signal Detection Theory
Week 5: Lecture: Information Theory and Axiomatic Design
Week 6: Demonstration: FaceLab Gaze Tracking System
Week 7: Lecture: Mental Models and Card Sorting (Read assigned paper)
Week 8: Discussion 3: Assigned paper and Attention (Read assigned paper)
Week 9: Mid-term exam
Week 10: Discussion 4: Assigned paper and Mental Workload (Read assigned paper)
Week 11: Discussion 5: Assigned paper and Situation Awareness
Week 12: Lecture: Applications
Week 13: Lecture: Applications
Week 14: Paper Presentation
Week 15: Paper Presentation
Week 16: Paper Presentation
Week 17: Team Final Report
Week 18: Team Final Report
assessment:
Mid-term exam: 30%
Discussion: 5% x5 = 25%
Paper presentation: 20%
Seminar report: 5%
Team final report 20%
